mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , ia.fund_nm AS xxFundCd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , cj.hj_nm AS hjNm , cj.hj_nm AS xxHjNm , f_pg_cd(t1.corp_gr, t1.ymd, t1.jm_cd) AS pgCd , NVL(t1.bfil_aekm, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aekm, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aekm, 0) AS aekm , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.meib_aek, 0) - NVL(t1.medo_aek, 0) AS aek , t1.siga_aek AS sigaAek , t1.ip_user AS ipUser FROM SHM0HM t1 , SZM0IA ia , SHM0HJ cj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, '2999.12.31') > #{ymd} AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND cj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC, t1.jm_cd ASC
